title: International Fund for Agricultural Development Act 1977
converter: cth_convert_sym_v11.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (workbench)

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-13 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word document of C2004A01728 (download_sha256 b6ed63c6f0e3a8e51f4e24d08d2d8ecb21056d001c36a8b8e5611966501e9d3b, unchanged)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: The Word document types the note mark of the total freely convertible contributions in Part II of Schedule I of the Agreement (pledges of initial contributions) in the Symbol font as a w:sym element (F02A, an asterisk), which docx_text() dropped, so the amount was no longer tied to its note. cth_convert_sym_v11.py maps Symbol-font w:sym elements and private-use code points U+F0xx to Unicode (F02A *, F0B7 •, F0B4 ×, F0A3 ≤, F0B3 ≥ and the like) and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]"; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: A diff against the first deposit shows only these 2 lines changed (same 742 lines; 3 characters added): line 657, the total freely convertible contributions in Part II of Schedule I of the Agreement (pledges of initial contributions), "884 853 780" now "884 853 780*"; and line 660, its note, now "* Equivalent of $US1,011,776,023 valued as of 10 June 1976." (the asterisk and the space after it restored).
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none (the subject has no encodings and no formulas sidecar)
